    <p>AI supports much of my research, teaching, and service. Everything is launched and

         projects and several live AI sessions across two machines got hard to hold in my head.</p>

  <div class="stem"></div>

  <!-- RESEARCH -->
  <details class="dom mature" open>
    <summary>
      <span class="pn">Research</span>
      <span class="sdesc">The full pipeline, from monitoring through to review.</span>
      <span class="chev">&#8250;</span>
    </summary>
    <div class="body">
      <p class="swim-intro">The researcher owns every decision that shapes a finding. AI joins at specific
        stages to add reach and volume, and stays out where judgment is the whole job.</p>

      <div class="watershed">
        <div class="tag">Always running</div>
        <div class="pills">
          <div class="pill">Monitor <small>literature, conferences, feeds</small></div>
          <div class="pill">Collect <small>standing data assets, scrapers</small></div>
        </div>
        <div class="downarrow"><svg width="30" height="36" viewBox="0 0 34 40" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 0 h10 v22 h8 l-13 16 -13 -16 h8 z" fill="#aebeca"/></svg></div>
      </div>

      <div class="scroll">
        <div class="matrix">
          <div></div>
          <div class="stage">Idea</div><div class="stage">Identification</div><div class="stage">Data</div>
          <div class="stage">Analysis</div><div class="stage">Writing</div><div class="stage">Dissemination</div>

          <div class="lane researcher">Researcher</div>
          <div class="cell researcher">Frame the question</div>
          <div class="cell researcher">Strategy, specification, methods</div>
          <div class="cell researcher">What data, and why</div>
          <div class="cell researcher">Interpret the findings</div>
          <div class="cell researcher">The argument &amp; synthesis</div>
          <div class="cell researcher">The claims &amp; narrative</div>

          <div class="lane ai">AI</div>
          <div class="cell ai">Surface related work</div>
          <div class="cell empty">judgment alone</div>
          <div class="cell ai">Build &amp; debug pipelines, scrape, validate</div>
          <div class="cell ai">Run 100s of robustness checks; draft tables &amp; figures</div>
          <div class="cell ai">Help rephrase, identify problem areas, suggest edits</div>
          <div class="cell ai">Generate decks, tables, figures; sync the record</div>

          <div class="lane principle">Principle</div>
          <div class="cell rule"><span><strong>Never</strong> let AI originate the question</span></div>
          <div class="cell rule"><span><strong>Never</strong> delegate the research design</span></div>
          <div class="cell rule"><span><strong>Never</strong> trust a pipeline I haven't checked</span></div>
          <div class="cell rule"><span><strong>Never</strong> let AI interpret a result</span></div>
          <div class="cell rule"><span><strong>Never</strong> use AI to draft from scratch</span></div>
          <div class="cell rule"><span><strong>Never</strong> send out anything I haven't vetted</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="skills-head">Tools behind it</div>
      <div class="tiles three">
        <div class="tile">
          <div class="tn">Monitor &amp; Collect</div>
          <div class="td">Tracks new literature and maintains my standing datasets.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="tile">
          <div class="tn">Referee</div>
          <div class="td">Reviews my own paper drafts for weaknesses before I submit.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="tile">
          <div class="tn">Sync</div>
          <div class="td">Publishes approved updates to my CV and website.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </details>

  <!-- TEACHING -->
  <details class="dom">
    <summary>
      <span class="pn">Teaching</span>

  <!-- SERVICE -->
  <details class="dom">
    <summary>
      <span class="pn">Service</span>
      <span class="sdesc">Reviewing others&rsquo; work.</span>
      <span class="chev">&#8250;</span>

    <div class="body">
      <div class="tiles one">
        <div class="tile">
          <div class="tn">Referee reports</div>
          <div class="td">I write the review. AI checks that I read the paper correctly and missed nothing. It does not write the assessment.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </details>

</div>
